title: Budgard
description: A personal expense tracker PWA that fits in your pocket — installs like a native app, syncs across devices, and just works.
features: Log expenses with amount, category, tag, date, currency, and drag-and-drop receipt photos (WebP compressed).
Expense templates and recurring schedules — weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly — generated automatically via Edge Functions.
Multi-currency support with live exchange rates, plus CSV import and export.
Analytics view with monthly snapshots, category breakdowns, sparkline trends, and year-over-year drill-down charts.
Monthly budgets with color-coded progress alerts at 75%, 90%, and 100%.
Spending insights — projections, peak days, weekend vs weekday patterns.
Three themes (dark, light, Barbie) and seven accent colors, with custom emoji-tagged categories.
Push notifications for due recurring expenses, inactivity nudges, and daily reminders.
PWA — installs on iOS, Android, and desktop, with offline support and automatic sync.
Shareable monthly report cards exportable as PNG.
English and Greek language support, auto-detected.
Passwordless auth via email magic links.
